description: Searches ServerScan's published guides on PCI DSS requirements, ASV scanning, choosing or switching ASV, scan failures, payment page monitoring and penetration testing. Returns up to five matching guides with a short excerpt and a link each. Use it to answer a PCI question from our own pages, then cite the link. For current prices, call get_pricing.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words. For example "requirement 11.6.1", "TLS 1.0 scan failure" or "SAQ A-EP".

name: search_guides

results.description: Best match first. Empty when nothing matches.

resource_uri.description: The same guide as an MCP resource, in full.

title: Search ServerScan guides
